svg.aria-label: Between a crash and a rerun: a process killed inside a tool leaves the pre-tool row as the newest, and resume re-invokes the tool with the saved arguments without calling the model; a process killed waiting on the model leaves the turn row, and resume re-issues the model without re-running the tool; when two tools were asked for in one turn and the first paused, the sibling is not re-dispatched on resume and the model is told it did not run; a tool re-invoked after a crash that then pauses raises InterruptSignal out of resume in 1.87.0.
svg.title: Between a crash and a rerun: a process killed inside a tool leaves the pre-tool row as the newest, and resume re-invokes the tool with the saved arguments without calling the model; a process killed waiting on the model leaves the turn row, and resume re-issues the model without re-running the tool; when two tools were asked for in one turn and the first paused, the sibling is not re-dispatched on resume and the model is told it did not run; a tool re-invoked after a crash that then pauses raises InterruptSignal out of resume in 1.87.0.
svg.text: Between a crash and a rerun — resume re-enters at the newest row
resume → the tool runs with its saved args
model calls on resume: 1 (the next turn), charges: 1
resume → the model is re-issued at turn 1
model calls on resume: 1, charges: 0 — the tool is not re-run
two tools in one turn; the first pauses
turn 0: refund(1042, 50000) → pauses notify(1042) → never dispatched
resume: refund runs with the Resume; notify is NOT re-dispatched — resume re-enters at a row, never mid-turn
the model is shown: 'the agent stopped before this tool ran, so it was not run' and may ask again
a row is written before the step, so every crash has a re-entry point; nothing committed is repeated
the re-entered step runs from the top: wrap its side effects in @idempotent (next section)
1.87.0: a tool re-invoked by crash recovery that then calls interrupt() raises InterruptSignal
out of resume() — no paused result, nothing checkpointed. Found by proof 3; open.
Proof 3 kills a real child process with os._exit at each point and resumes in the parent.
